description: [JIP-3] Network-wide overview — live stats, events, blocks, health, and aggregates

panels.title: Active Nodes
panels.description: [JIP-3] Number of nodes currently connected to the telemetry server.

panels.title: Best Slot
panels.description: [JIP-3] Highest slot number reported by any node via BestBlockChanged (11).

panels.title: Finalized Slot
panels.description: [JIP-3] Latest finalized slot reported via FinalizedBlockChanged (12).

panels.title: Events/sec (10s)
panels.description: [JIP-3] Total telemetry events ingested per second, averaged over the last 10 seconds. Covers all event types from all nodes.

panels.title: Blocks/sec (10s)
panels.description: [JIP-3] Authored (42) events per second, averaged over the last 10 seconds. One count per block produced by any node.

panels.title: Events by Type
panels.description: [JIP-3] Network-wide event counts grouped by event type name. All events from all nodes — each line is one event type's count per interval. (1-minute buckets from all_event_stats_1m)

panels.title: Events by Node
panels.description: [JIP-3] Network-wide event counts grouped by node. Each line is one node's total event volume per interval. (1-minute buckets from all_event_stats_1m)
Event counts for individually selected event types.
panels.title: Selected Events
Failure Rates
panels.description: [JIP-3] All failure and discard events across the network: AuthoringFailed (41), BlockVerificationFailed (44), BlockExecutionFailed (46), BlockRequestFailed (65), TicketGenerationFailed (81), TicketTransferFailed (83), WorkPackageFailed (92), DuplicateWorkPackage (93), WorkPackageSharingFailed (99), GuaranteeSendFailed (107), GuaranteeReceiveFailed (111), GuaranteeDiscarded (113), ShardRequestFailed (122), AssuranceSendFailed (127), AssuranceReceiveFailed (130), and others. Grouped by type. (1-minute buckets from all_event_stats_1m)

[JIP-3] Per-node counts of the event types picked in the Event Type variable — one line per reporting node, legend sorted by total so the top senders come first. Same data as Selected Events, split by node (group_by=node_id). Resolution follows the range: 30-second counts below 1-minute intervals, 1-minute / 1-hour aggregates above.
panels.title: Selected Events by Node

panels.description: [JIP-3] Nodes ranked by how many of the selected event types they reported in the time range (top 100), with each node's share of the network-wide total and its handshake identity: address, implementation, version, connection state, last seen. Click a Node ID to open the TART Node dashboard for it.
panels.title: Top Senders (Selected Events)
Block Production
panels.description: [JIP-3] Authored (42) events per interval — one count per block produced by any node. (1-minute buckets from event_stats_1m)

panels.title: Pipeline Activity
panels.description: [JIP-3] Three series showing the block production pipeline: Authored (42), WP pipeline (WorkPackageReceived through GuaranteesDistributed, types 90–109), and guarantee receiving (ReceivingGuarantee through GuaranteeDiscarded, types 110–113). (1-minute buckets)

panels.title: Block Composition
panels.description: [JIP-3] Contents of each authored block over time: number of guarantees, assurances, preimages, and tickets included. Extracted from Authored (42) event payload. Stacked bars.

panels.title: WP Funnel
panels.description: [JIP-3] Work package pipeline summary: how many WPs were received (WorkPackageReceived 94), authorized (Authorized 95), refined (Refined 101), built into guarantees (GuaranteeBuilt 105), distributed (GuaranteesDistributed 109), and how many failed (WorkPackageFailed 92). Snapshot over the selected time range. (from wp_tracking)

panels.title: Pipeline Bottlenecks
panels.description: [JIP-3] Pipeline health metrics: total WPs processed, failure count and rate, average pipeline latency from WorkPackageReceived to GuaranteeBuilt in milliseconds. (from wp_tracking)

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: [JIP-3] All nodes that have connected to the telemetry server. Shows implementation name, version, connection status, and last seen time.

panels.title: Data Availability by Node
panels.description: [JIP-3] Per-node data availability storage: number of shards and preimages held, with sizes. Extracted from Status (10) events. (from node_stats)

panels.title: DA Aggregate
panels.description: [JIP-3] Network-wide data availability summary: max shard/preimage counts and sizes, average peer count. Extracted from Status (10) events. (from node_stats_1m)

title: TART Global (JIP-3)
